t: The Fortress Trade 4" Roller Tray inserts are essential painting accessories for trade professionals and serious DIYers. These transparent plastic liners are designed for use with the Fortress Trade 4" Roller tray, providing a convenient solution for managing paint during decoration projects. The 3-pack ensures multiple uses, ideal for when working with various paint colours or to facilitate quicker clean-up between different painting tasks. These durable plastic inserts measure 330mm high, 175mm wide, and 50mm deep, ensuring a precise fit within the corresponding roller tray and offering a practical way to maintain clean paint trays and extend their lifespan.
b: Compatible with Fortress Trade 4" Roller Tray
